title: The Sin of Achan

questions.question: Who took of the devoted things?
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:1 (ESV): "...Achan the son of Carmi... took some of the devoted things..."

questions.question: What city did Joshua send men to spy out after Jericho?
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:2 (ESV): "Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai..."

questions.question: What happened when the men of Israel attacked Ai initially?
options: They fled before the men of Ai
questions.correctAnswer: They fled before the men of Ai
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:4 (ESV): "So about three thousand men went up there from the people. And they fled before the men of Ai..."

questions.question: How did Joshua react to the defeat at Ai?
options: He tore his clothes and fell to the earth on his face before the ark
He got angry at the soldiers
questions.correctAnswer: He tore his clothes and fell to the earth on his face before the ark
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:6 (ESV): "Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell to the earth on his face before the ark of the Lord..."

questions.question: What did God say was the reason for the defeat?
options: Israel has sinned; they have transgressed my covenant
questions.correctAnswer: Israel has sinned; they have transgressed my covenant
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:11 (ESV): "Israel has sinned; they have transgressed my covenant that I commanded them..."

questions.question: How was the guilty person found?
options: By lot, tribe by tribe, clan by clan, family by family
questions.correctAnswer: By lot, tribe by tribe, clan by clan, family by family
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:14 (ESV): "...tribe which the Lord takes... clan which the Lord takes... family..."

questions.question: What did Achan confess to taking?
options: A beautiful cloak from Shinar, 200 shekels of silver, and a bar of gold weighing 50 shekels
questions.correctAnswer: A beautiful cloak from Shinar, 200 shekels of silver, and a bar of gold weighing 50 shekels
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:21 (ESV): "...a beautiful cloak from Shinar, and 200 shekels of silver, and a bar of gold..."

questions.question: Where had Achan hidden the stolen items?
options: In the earth inside his tent
questions.correctAnswer: In the earth inside his tent
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:21 (ESV): "...Behold, they are hidden in the earth inside my tent..."

questions.question: What happened to Achan and his family?
options: They were stoned with stones and burned with fire
questions.correctAnswer: They were stoned with stones and burned with fire
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:25 (ESV): "And all Israel stoned him with stones. They burned them with fire and stoned them with stones."

questions.question: What is the name of the place where Achan was executed?
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:26 (ESV): "Therefore the name of that place is called the Valley of Achor to this day."

questions.question: How many men of Israel were killed in the initial battle of Ai?
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:5 (ESV): "and the men of Ai killed about thirty-six of their men..."

questions.question: What tribe was Achan from?
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:1 (ESV): "...Achan the son of Carmi... of the tribe of Judah..."

questions.question: Why did the spies suggest not sending all the people to Ai?
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:3 (ESV): "...do not make all the people toil up there, for they are few."

questions.question: What does "Achor" mean?
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:25 (ESV): "And Joshua said, 'Why did you bring trouble on us? The Lord brings trouble on you today.'" Achor relates to trouble.

questions.question: Until what time did Joshua and the elders remain on their faces?
questions.explanation: Joshua 7:6 (ESV): "...and they fell to the earth on their faces before the ark of the Lord until the evening..."

key_verse_text: Get up! Consecrate the people and say, “Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow; for thus says the LORD, God of Israel, ‘There are devoted things in your midst, O Israel. You cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the devoted things from among you.’” (ESV)
